description: This file defines the UpdateAccountingRuleCommandHandler class, which handles update commands for accounting rules in the Fineract accounting module. It uses Spring annotations and interacts with the AccountingRuleWritePlatformService to process update commands.

classes.name: UpdateAccountingRuleCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update commands for accounting rules, implementing processing logic via the writePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by calling the write platform service to update the accounting rule.
